'''Pergitor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] settled by [[Jesa Corporation]] miners.<ref name="GG6" /> 

==Description==
===Before the disaster===
Pergitor was a lush tropical [[Planet/Legends|world]] known for its [[Garden/Legends|gardens]], first settled by the [[Jesa Corporation]] for the extremely rare [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits found in its [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] regions. The planet soon became the corporation's major training and research center, with many [[Scientist/Legends|scientific researchers]] and [[Technician/Legends|techinicians]] living on its surface as part of what was considered a fairly advanced civilization.<ref name="GG6" />

===After the disaster===
After a deep bore mining project caused a devastating volcanic eruption between [[99 BBY/Legends|99 BBY]] and [[89 BBY]] the world was covered in ash for various [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was made unbreathable, destorying the ecosystem of the formerly lush planet. The inhabitants were forced to retreat to sealed buildings and Jesa Corporation went out of business, leaving the planet with a devastated economy.<ref name="GG6" />

==Society==
===Before the disaster===
At its earliest inception, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]'s population was strongly united by the fundamentalist ideas of [[Jesa Corporation]]'s [[Jesa Corporation's founder|founder]], a woman of extremely rigid moral principles and personal beliefs that some considered 'strange'. Many of the early future inhabitants were recluted because they were of like mind, but later waves of immigrants usually accepted the laws and traditions of the conservative society they had joined without necessarily approving of them.<ref name="GG6" />

===After the disaster===
After the damage the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruption had done to the environment, all surviving inhabitants were forced to wear [[Breath mask/Legends|gas masks]] at all times when outside and to retreat to sealed buildings. With Jesa Corp going bankrupt and with everyone being more interested in survival than anything else, the society on the planet turned into a despotism under the control of the [[Royal family of Pergitor|royal family]], composed of descendants of Jesa Corp's founder. After having been ruled this way for about 70 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], around [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_4.html|Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead}}, set on the date 13:3:7 and corresponding to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]], states that fifteen years have passed since the young liberal's coup therefore dating said coup to [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]].</ref> a group of young liberals started to rebel by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] illegal goods from off-planet such as synthetic drugs and prohibited [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]]. They started to make use of what they had smuggled and openly protested against the repressive governemnt, drawing in even some of the younger members of the royal family. The liberal movement weakened the despotical government, resulting in the establishment of a liberal one that lasted for 15 years. The royal family was still present during this era of the planet's history.<ref name="GG6" />
However, around [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] the [[Church of Infinite Perception/Legends|Church of Infinite Perception]], whose leaders were exiled with the rise of the liberals, gained new power from the disenchanted conservatives who were unsatisfied with the new government, considering it disorganized. They launched a [[Coup on Pergitor|coup]] exiling the royal family and installing a [[Theocracy|theocracy]] under the leadership of a man simpy called '[[The Preceptor]]'.<ref name="GG6" /> Thousands were killed by the Church but due to Pergitor's nebulous affiliation with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], neither the Republic nor the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] could do anything to stop the bloody revolt.<ref name="HNN 46>''{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_4.html|Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead}}''</ref> The [[Pergitor Resistance]] was later founded in secret by citiziens of the planet dissatisfied with the new turn of events.<ref name="GG6" />

===Imperial Era===
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] strongly supported the rigid fundamentalist theocracy of Pergitor, supplying the planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] with 600 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] the Church often used to put down political demonstrations when the local armed forces weren't willing to do the job. In return for their services, the government allowed the Empire to recruit heavily from Pergitor for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="GG6" />

===The Church of Infinite Perception===
The Church of Infinite Perception was a rigid, fundamentalist religious organization that predated the coup made by the liberals around [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]]. As of [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] it was ruled by '[[The Preceptor]]' and had imposed various rules over Pergitor's population.<ref name="GG6" />

The Church had inspectors working indepedently from [[Imperial Customs Official|Imperial Customs officials]], ensuring that both inhabitants and visitors of the planet respected the strict rules imposed by the Church. Such rules prohibited the use of any kind of drug, including medications, the use of paranormal abilities, the importing of any sort of luxury good and even the simple act of singing, joking or watching holos in public. Infraction of said rules was considered a state crime, alongside committing any kind of sacrilege against the Church. Breaking a state crime often resulted in a summary [[Death penalty/Legends|execution]], although people had been known to get simply arrested for state crimes such as laughing in public.<ref name="GG6" /> 

Despite its own rules, the Church itself was one of the largest operators in the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], reguarly organizing shippings of luxury goods. 15 years after the establishment of the theocracy, this fact was still unknown to the public.<ref name="GG6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Pergitor, alongside its history, was first presented in [[West End Games]]' [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters|Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]. Despite it not giving a precise date for the events it covers, Galaxy Guides are supplements to WEG's [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] which is set in the years after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope]] but before [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]. Dating the supplement to the time period of the core rulebook would place Pergitor's bore mining disaster between [[99 BBY/Legends|99 BBY]] and [[89 BBY]], having happened nearly 100 years before the Guide's present-day. In the same vein, the liberal movement on the planet would've started around between [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] and [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] with the [[Coup on Pergitor|coup]] happening between [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] and [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]].

On [[March 7]], [[2002]] the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website [[HoloNet News (original website)|Holonet News]] that was created as part of the marketing campaign for the [[2002]] theatrical release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] posted [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 46]]<ref name="HNN 46" /> featuring an article about the [[Church of Infinite Perception/Legends|Church]]'s counter-coup on Pergitor, dating the event to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] and subsequently preponing all of Pergitor's history by about eight years.
